chapters.title: Detroit in 1978: why automation was not enough
AI adoption and misleading productivity metrics
Redesigning the system: from steam engines to NUMMI

Measuring outcomes and building the right thing

existingSummary: Mo Khazali compares AI adoption with the automotive industry’s automation push, then applies lean principles to software delivery: shared platforms, continuous learning, quality gates and measures of customer value.
